in_marathi.name: Kalanvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Descendant of Kala
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kalanvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kalanvansh is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Kala’ meaning ‘Time’ and ‘Vansh’ meaning ‘Descendants’ or ‘Lineage’. This name signifies someone who belongs to the lineage of Kala, a significant deity in Hindu mythology. In Hindu tradition, Kala is often depicted as the God of Time and Destiny, and is believed to control the cosmic cycle of creation and destruction.
